Their flagship product digitizes unstructured data from various sources into structured workflows, reducing manual data entry and optimizing routing and inventory for freight brokers, carriers, and logistics providers. The platform includes a Transportation Management System (TMS) and a Warehouse Management System (WMS), designed to enhance operational efficiency and customer service. Pallet's solutions are tailored for B2B clients in the logistics sector, including freight brokers, cartage companies, and third-party logistics providers. With a focus on AI-driven automation and seamless integration, Pallet aims to help enterprise-scale logistics operators reduce costs and improve service delivery.
